analysis: Standalone FromConfig loads the internal config but does not populate configAPIResource; runtime only stores a raw Configuration when that variable is non-null. A watched directory event loads accesscontrol as an untracked Configuration and the reconciler sends SIGHUP to itself. Co-location and separation controls execute the same deny-by-default config bytes with HotReload enabled. Only the separation control avoids reload after the same non-resource event.
